findings: All four prescribed jobs exhausted their unchanged two-hour budget with verified owned-process cleanup. Peak RSS1.08–1.62GiB remained far below8GiB; these are timeout outcomes, not memory-limit failures.
Both full fits completed propagation closure but remained at point-001-initial. The recorded bottleneck is fitting GNSS nuisance parameters before the first physical trial.

All completed recorded nuisance steps accepted alpha1 with positive actual reduction, fixed observation signature and conditional full-rank status. They were still contracting rather than showing recorded line-search stagnation; neither convergence nor accepted covariance was produced.

Parent weighted-row construction accounts for3139–3370s in completed iterations; zero-update and ordinary trial replays add1959–2261s. Design/interpolation is nested in parent build and must not be added twice. Unallocated wall time cannot be assigned exclusively to QR.

Pulse design storage has severe measured logical read amplification: parent counters244.7–285.5GB for a0.810GB store, with only1290–1505hits against244704–285488block loads. This identifies a cache/locality investigation, not a proven correctness defect or guaranteed speedup.

Parent row building still computes dynamic observation designs even during fixed-physical nuisance solves; child cost-only replays and recovery already omit them. Whether parent designs can be omitted without changing required metadata/conditioning needs separate equivalence tests.

Fixed-point diagnostic row archives retain8.69GB(pulse) and39.67GB(density). Whole-fit retention differs. Retention volume alone does not measure write time, and the archive difference precludes treating fixed-point/whole-fit durations as a controlled speed comparison.
limitations: Freshly rehashed all27 frozen protocol controls, including native executable, and four attempt JSON identities. Full bulky input/runtime dependency inventories were not rehashed; startup/result isolation and identity checks are recorded evidence.
Observed source-row and conditional-rank diagnostics apply to the nuisance subproblem, not full physical rank certification.
Performance instrumentation excludes nuisance solves, local recovery and parameter update as separate parent stages; unfinished iterations, setup and closure also consume unallocated wall time.
Logical read counters are cumulative and fork-inherited. Only latest parent counter per store is used; they are not physical-device I/O measurements.
No speedup or root-cause claim is established by these four failed attempts. Approximate contraction and TEC update logs motivate further exact-model inspection.
Native logs were hashed completely and retained as bounded prefix/suffix plus filtered lines. Large row spools were not read completely; first-row archive prefixes are hashed where captured.
Existing frozen benchmark and all original results remain unchanged. No corrected candidate result replaces a frozen outcome.
